title: UBTECH and FAW Volkswagen sign deal to test humanoid robots for factory logistics
key_facts: UBTECH Robotics, based in Shenzhen, and joint-venture automaker FAW Volkswagen signed a strategic cooperation agreement to develop and test humanoid robots for factory logistics.
It builds on earlier trials at FAW Volkswagen plants including Qingdao, where UBTECH Walker S robots were evaluated for quality control, bolt tightening and component assembly.
The expanded pilot will test material transport, inventory sorting and workstation replenishment alongside human workers.
The companies will build demonstration scenarios inside working assembly facilities.
No fleet procurement quantities or commercial deployment dates were disclosed.
quote_evidence: Shenzhen-based robotics developer UBTECH Robotics and joint-venture automaker FAW Volkswagen have signed a strategic cooperation agreement to develop and test humanoid robots for industrial factory logistics.
No immediate fleet procurement quantities or commercial deployment dates were disclosed.
why_it_matters_hint: Humanoid robots move from inspecting parts to carrying and sorting materials in a car plant, as a pilot.
